title: Implement a Trie data structure in Go
description: Greenfield Go task: implement a Trie with Insert, Search (exact word), StartsWith (prefix), and CountWords methods using a map-based node structure.

required_artifacts: TrieNode with children map[rune]*TrieNode and isEnd bool
Insert creates missing nodes and sets isEnd=true at end
Insert only increments wordCount on first insertion of each word
Search returns node.isEnd at word's last rune, false if node missing
StartsWith walks prefix path, returns true on success (empty prefix = true)
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
